# ClaudeFast

> > ClaudeFast: AI-led development and growth marketing platform featuring 16 specialized AI agents with 280+ skills for rapid prototyping and fullstack development.

ClaudeFast provides a comprehensive framework built on Claude Opus 4.6 for accelerating software development and growth marketing workflows. The platform integrates with modern tech stacks including React, Next.js, Supabase, SwiftUI, Flutter, and n8n, offering skill-activation hooks, context management, and auto-approval workflows for AI-driven project execution.

## Key Topics

- Claude Opus 4.6
- Specialized AI Agents
- Skill Activation Hooks
- Context Management
- Rapid Prototyping
- Auto-Approval Workflow
- Fullstack Development
- React & Next.js
- Supabase
- SwiftUI & Flutter
- n8n Automation
- OWASP Security
- Growth Marketing Kits
- AI Development Framework
- Claude Code
